html:
Update18 July 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - Jul 18, 2026
⚽ The World Cup Finals are here! Pick Spain or Argentina, bet your gold for a share of the prize pool, grab a free jersey & daily quests, plus World Boss Eggs have been reverted.

World Cup Finals ⚽

With the World Cup Final arriving on Sunday, we're celebrating with two limited-time events!

💰 World Cup Community Betting Pool

Think you know who's taking home the trophy?

Mail Aguru in-game with your wager (minimum 50 gold) and back either Spain or Argentina. If your team wins, you'll receive a share of the communal prize pool!

➡️ Current odds, rules and details: https://aa-classic.com/wcfinals

🇪🇸 Pick Your Side 🇦🇷

Aguru will be waiting on Mirage Isle to offer every player a free jersey for the team they'll be supporting!

Equip your jersey to unlock 2 World Cup daily quests, available until the Finals only. Show your support, rally your teammates, and (playfully) taunt your rivals before kickoff!

World Boss Changes

The World Boss Egg system has been reverted. Red Dragon, Kraken, and Hanure the Berserker have returned to fixed spawn schedules.

The experiment is over. The results weren't limited to the feature itself, and we'll be keeping that in mind the next time we're deciding whether to take a risk.

Timer Changes

The timers for the following bosses have been changed:

  • Hanure, the Berserker now spawns on Sundays at 3:30 PM (server time). Previous timer was Friday at 5:30 PM (server time)
  • Sunday Red Dragon now spawns on Fridays at 5:30 PM (server time). Previous timer was Sunday at 3:30 PM (server time)

Player Feedback Request

The team is interested in hearing player feedback regarding the following subjects, pertaining to bosses:

  • Reusing the "egg summoning system" with fixed timers
    • Egg appears when boss would have spawned, is up for 30 minutes
    • Boss can be summoned by channeling the egg (buffing the summoners)
    • Boss timer is reduced to 90 minutes (from current 120) allowing for shorter content windows when summoned early (or same length as today if summoned last second)
  • State of OCE Random Bosses (Saturday 5AM server time)

== World Cup Finals ⚽ ==

With the World Cup Final arriving on Sunday, we're celebrating with two limited-time events!

=== 💰 World Cup Community Betting Pool ===

Think you know who's taking home the trophy?

Mail '''Aguru''' in-game with your wager (minimum '''50 gold''') and back either '''Spain''' or '''Argentina'''. If your team wins, you'll receive a share of the communal prize pool!

➡️ '''Current odds, rules and details:''' https://aa-classic.com/wcfinals

=== 🇪🇸 Pick Your Side 🇦🇷 ===

Aguru will be waiting on '''Mirage Isle''' to offer every player a free jersey for the team they'll be supporting!

Equip your jersey to unlock '''2 World Cup daily quests''', available '''until the Finals''' only. Show your support, rally your teammates, and (playfully) taunt your rivals before kickoff!

== World Boss Changes ==

The World Boss Egg system has been reverted. '''Red Dragon''', '''Kraken''', and '''Hanure the Berserker''' have returned to fixed spawn schedules.

The experiment is over. The results weren't limited to the feature itself, and we'll be keeping that in mind the next time we're deciding whether to take a risk.

=== Timer Changes ===

The timers for the following bosses have been changed:

* '''Hanure, the Berserker''' now spawns on Sundays at 3:30 PM (server time). Previous timer was Friday at 5:30 PM (server time)
* '''Sunday Red Dragon''' now spawns on Fridays at 5:30 PM (server time). Previous timer was Sunday at 3:30 PM (server time)

=== Player Feedback Request ===

The team is interested in hearing player feedback regarding the following subjects, pertaining to bosses:

* Reusing the "egg summoning system" with fixed timers
** Egg appears when boss would have spawned, is up for 30 minutes
** Boss can be summoned by channeling the egg (buffing the summoners)
** Boss timer is reduced to 90 minutes (from current 120) allowing for shorter content windows when summoned early (or same length as today if summoned last second)
* State of OCE Random Bosses (Saturday 5AM server time)
